req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-002 requires GET /auth/register to return an HTTP 2xx response with a registration form. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns 200 with form fields present; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST without data still hits the route but a truly wrong method like PUT/DELETE should 405, and an unsupported path variant returns 404); (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 302) and exact content-type header. Additional tests assert the HTML payload contains the expected form elements (action, input names) to catch mutations that alter the template path or response body. All tests are self-contained, use in-process Flask test client, and assert exact values.

Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200_with_form():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'<form' in r.data
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data

test_register_get_returns_200_with_form()
